text:
The Tiki Totem was most likely introduced in desktop patch 1.2, which matches the team note. My earlier answer that I could not confirm it was wrong to stop there, but this is not fully verified. The fetched wiki page reported "Desktop 1.2: Introduced," yet a search snippet tied that same history line to Tiki armor, so the line may belong to the armor rather than the Totem. The Witch Doctor, which sells the Totem, also dates to 1.2.

CONFIDENCE: 65
